Let me write with export const arrow async.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_f3B8pRH6D1bv9PQOKLM41492","type":"function","function":{"name":"propose_change_set","arguments":"{"changes": [{"file": "handler.ts", "content": "import { verifyJwt } from \"zttp:auth\";\n\nconst BEARER_PREFIX = \"Bearer \";\n\nfunction unauthorized(): Response {\n  return Response.json({ authenticated: false }, { status: 401 });\n}\n\nexport const handle = async (\n  request: Request,\n  env: { readonly JWT_SECRET: string },\n): Promise<Response> => {\n  const header = request.headers.get(\"authorization\");\n  if (header === null || !header.startsWith(BEARER_PREFIX)) {\n    return unauthorized();\n  }\n\n  const token = header.slice(BEARER_PREFIX.length).trim();\n  if (token.length === 0) {\n    return unauthorized();\n  }\n\n  const claims = await verifyJwt(token, env.JWT_SECRET);\n  if (claims === null) {\n    return unauthorized();\n  }\n\n  return Response.json({ authenticated: true });\n};\n"}]}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":6345,"completion_tokens":445,"total_tokens":6790,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":5504},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":164},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":5504,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":841},"system_fingerprint":"bc19ba97cbe016479903222bb1578db6"}
